---
title: Great Salt Lake Forecast
title-block-style: none
---

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
bundle = FileAttachment("data/latest.json").json()
status = FileAttachment("data/status.json").json()
targets = bundle.targets ?? []
headline = targets[0]
formatMonth = (value) => value ? new Date(`${value}T00:00:00`).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {month: "long", year: "numeric"}) : "Pending"
formatFeet = (value) => Number.isFinite(value) ? `${value.toFixed(2)} ft` : "Not available"
formatValue = (value) => Number.isFinite(value) ? value.toFixed(3) : "Not used"
formatContribution = (value) => Number.isFinite(value) ? `${value >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${value.toFixed(3)} ft` : "Not available"
stale = status.attempted_issue && bundle.issue && status.attempted_issue !== bundle.issue
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
headlineView = headline ? html`<section class="headline-band">
  <div>
    <p class="eyebrow">${formatMonth(headline.month)} monthly mean</p>
    <p class="headline-number">${formatFeet(headline.pred)}</p>
    <p class="range">90% interval ${formatFeet(headline.q05)}–${formatFeet(headline.q95)}</p>
  </div>
  <dl class="issue-facts">
    <div><dt>Issued</dt><dd>${bundle.issue}</dd></div>
    <div><dt>Model</dt><dd>${bundle.headline_model}</dd></div>
    <div><dt>Data through</dt><dd>${status.data_max ?? "Pending"}</dd></div>
  </dl>
</section>` : html`<section class="headline-band pending">
  <div><p class="eyebrow">Next monthly mean</p><p class="headline-number">Pending</p>
  <p class="range">The first complete headline issue has not run.</p></div>
</section>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
staleNotice = stale
  ? html`<div class="data-notice" role="status">The latest run had incomplete inputs. This page keeps the complete ${bundle.issue} issue.</div>`
  : html``
```

## Forecast path

The line is the current headline model. The band contains the central 90% of past
walk-forward errors at each lead.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
history = (bundle.observations ?? []).map(d => ({...d, month: new Date(`${d.month}T00:00:00`)}))
path = targets.map(d => ({...d, month: new Date(`${d.month}T00:00:00`)}))
forecastPlot = path.length ? Plot.plot({
  height: 410,
  marginLeft: 62,
  marginBottom: 44,
  x: {label: null, grid: false},
  y: {label: "Elevation (ft)", grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(path, {x: "month", y1: "q05", y2: "q95", fill: "#98c9cb", fillOpacity: 0.42}),
    Plot.lineY(history, {x: "month", y: "elevation", stroke: "#202a27", strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.lineY(path, {x: "month", y: "pred", stroke: "#087f8c", strokeWidth: 3}),
    Plot.dot(path.slice(0, 1), {x: "month", y: "pred", fill: "#c84a3d", r: 5}),
    Plot.ruleY([4190], {stroke: "#c49a27", strokeDasharray: "5,4"})
  ]
}) : html`<p class="empty-state">Forecast data will appear after the next complete run.</p>`
```

## Held-out error

Mean absolute error from predictions for years excluded from blend calibration.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
scoreLeads = new Set([1, 6, 12, 24])
scores = (bundle.calibration?.held_out_mae ?? []).filter(d => scoreLeads.has(d.h))
scoreView = scores.length ? html`<dl class="score-band">
  ${scores.map(d => html`<div><dt>${d.h}-month</dt><dd>${d.mae_ft.toFixed(3)} ft</dd><small>${d.n} forecasts</small></div>`)}
</dl>` : html`<p class="empty-state compact">Held-out scores will appear with the next calibrated issue.</p>`
```

## What moves each date

Each bar is the fitted contribution relative to the historical input mean for that cutoff
month. The terms add to the selected point forecast with the reference path.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
targetOptions = targets.length ? targets.map(d => ({label: formatMonth(d.month), value: d.h})) : [{label: "Pending", value: 1}]
viewof selectedH = Inputs.select(targetOptions, {label: "Target month", format: d => d.label, value: targetOptions[0]})
selectedLead = selectedH.value
selected = targets.find(d => d.h === selectedLead)
labels = ({
  avg_elevation: "Current lake level",
  swe_eom_gsl: "Snow water equivalent",
  prec_wy_eom_gsl: "Water-year precipitation",
  head_diff_ft: "Arm head difference"
})
drivers = (selected?.contributions ?? [])
  .filter(d => d.input !== "reference_path")
  .map(d => ({...d, label: labels[d.input] ?? d.input}))
reference = (selected?.contributions ?? []).find(d => d.input === "reference_path")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
driverSummary = selected ? html`<div class="target-summary">
  <span><strong>${formatFeet(selected.pred)}</strong> forecast</span>
  <span><strong>${Math.round(selected.swe_weight * 100)}%</strong> SWE-model weight</span>
  <span><strong>${formatFeet(reference?.contribution_ft)}</strong> reference path</span>
</div>` : html``
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
driverPlot = drivers.length ? Plot.plot({
  height: 260,
  marginLeft: 170,
  marginBottom: 42,
  x: {label: "Contribution to elevation (ft)", grid: true},
  y: {label: null, domain: drivers.map(d => d.label)},
  color: {domain: ["Lower", "Raise"], range: ["#c84a3d", "#087f8c"], legend: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(drivers, {x: "contribution_ft", y: "label", fill: d => d.contribution_ft < 0 ? "Lower" : "Raise", tip: true}),
    Plot.ruleX([0], {stroke: "#202a27"})
  ]
}) : html`<p class="empty-state">Input contributions will appear with the first complete issue.</p>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
driverDetails = drivers.length ? html`<dl class="driver-values">
  ${drivers.map(d => html`<div>
    <dt>${d.label}</dt>
    <dd class="driver-contribution">${formatContribution(d.contribution_ft)}</dd>
    <dd>Input ${formatValue(d.value)}; historical mean ${formatValue(d.reference)}</dd>
  </div>`)}
</dl>` : html``
```
